page_title: Buy Once Software | The One-Time Purchase Software Directory

sources.entry: Buy software, once - The place to find all the software you can buy one time, and own for a lifetime.

summary.name: Buy Once Software
summary.one_liner: A directory of one-time purchase (perpetual license) Mac and desktop software listed as an alternative to subscription-based tools.
use_cases: find software to buy once instead of subscribing
manage files and clouds on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page is a directory that promotes one-time purchase software as an alternative to subscriptions, covering productivity, design, business, and developer tools. It lists a range of individual apps with short descriptions, including a native Mac file manager, a media manager, desktop bookkeeping and payroll software, an M4B audiobook builder, local subtitle generation powered by OpenAI, offline speech-to-text dictation, a project manager with peer-to-peer sync, a Mac optimization utility, data recovery, an icon organizer, a color contrast checker, a font pairing tool, and a screenshot tool. Pricing details are given per app where stated, and the directory itself is described as being about finding software you can own for life.
notable: Curated list of software sold as one-time purchase rather than subscription
Listed as a 'Genuine Sites' entry in the awesome-mac list
Entries cover a wide range of categories, mostly Mac-focused
Individual apps mention no-account, no-subscription, or offline/local processing
caveats: Directory page only; pricing and terms are per app and not stated on this page
Some listed apps are described as having limits, such as one-time purchase covering up to 3 Macs for one file manager
Platform support varies by listed app; Linux is not clearly named for any specific app on this page
